product_requirement.text: Complete measurement of all actionable controls and physical 44pt iOS / 48dp Android target checks remains under #303.

official_guideline.scope: Android recommends a minimum48dp touch/focus area; a smaller visual may use surrounding padding. This packet therefore measures actual activation at points around the visible/AX bounds.

distinction: QA301 product acceptance is the gate being checked. No OS-enforced system minimum or complete platform inventory is claimed.
